category.title: ActionScript 3
category.description: Tracked families of language features and Flash APIs. The completed share of this registry is not a percentage of Flash Player compatibility.

features.title: Source diagnostics
features.scope: Parse errors and unsupported frontend constructs report the language, line and column; compilation errors block export.
features.limitations: This guarantees compiler diagnostics, not verification of every Flash API semantic.

features.title: Literals
features.scope: Decimal, hexadecimal and exponent numbers; strings; Boolean, null, undefined, NaN and Infinity; arrays without holes and object literals. Static-name XML/XMLList literals with child and whole-attribute interpolation.
features.limitations: The full set of literals and historical Flash rules is not implemented; legacy numbers with leading zeroes are rejected. XML dynamic names, namespace interpolation and partial-attribute holes remain unsupported.

features.title: Variables and scope
features.scope: var, multiple declarations, handler-owner fields, and hoisting of local var declarations and parameters.
features.limitations: Handler fields differ from classes and the full Flash scope chain; top-level declarations follow documented reinitialization rules.

features.title: Arithmetic, logic and assignments
features.scope: Basic arithmetic, comparisons, short-circuit evaluation, bitwise operations, ++/-- and compound assignments. Membership and member/index deletion preserve original container keys; indexed compound/update writes evaluate receiver and key once.
features.limitations: Some operations use JavaScript coercion; this is not complete AVM semantics across all Flash Player versions.

features.title: If/else branches
features.scope: Parsing and execution of if/else, blocks and the conditional expression ?:, selecting one branch.
features.limitations: This covers control flow in the supported frontend; conversion of arbitrary Flash objects remains part of unfinished type compatibility.

features.title: Classic loops and jumps
features.scope: while, do/while, three-part for, and nested break/continue with jump-target validation.
features.limitations: for..in property enumeration and full compatibility of condition coercion are tracked separately. Independent a3fedc3 browser evidence covers the specific class/input scenarios in VERIFICATION.md; all untested members remain bounded or unverified.

features.title: Switch and fallthrough
features.scope: Single evaluation of the subject, sequential case matching, default, fallthrough and break.
features.limitations: The supported contract uses strict comparison; compatibility across Flash Player versions is not certified.

features.title: Function declarations and calls
features.scope: Function declarations/expressions, recursion, callbacks, scalar optional defaults and trailing rest; supplied arguments and call/apply forwarding. Constructor/method/interface signatures share normal/optional/rest metadata. Project methods retain stable bound identity and receiver through indirect calls.
features.limitations: General compile-time default expressions, arguments.caller, runtime-built Function code, full prototype/reflection, unrestricted dynamic lookup and complete AVM global/coercion semantics remain unfinished. Null/undefined unbound receivers use the documented NeoFlash source-frame convention. Independent 11a59df evidence (FUNCTIONS-HTML5-20261027T0914Z) covers the corrected command workflow: omitted versus undefined typed values, supplied count/callee, fresh rest arrays, stable bound identity, tested ordinary borrowed receiver, constructor observations and pre-mutation ArgumentError refusals with Restart. The original arguments.length instrumentation changed allow-extra behavior and remains separate; unobserved signatures/coercions/reflection/global-scope behavior are not accepted.

features.title: Closures and variable capture
features.scope: Lexical local variables, shadowing, closures retained after return, and capture of the handler owner.
features.limitations: The complete Flash receiver, global-object and scope-chain models are not implemented.

features.title: Function parameters and returns
features.scope: Bounded required/optional/rest signatures, supplied arguments, selected typed parameter/return conversion and return-path validation. Optional scalar defaults apply only to omission; explicit undefined follows normal typed conversion.
features.limitations: General compile-time default expressions, unrestricted argument/receiver coercion and complete Flash invocation errors remain unverified or unsupported. Use of arguments can enable extra supplied values in the documented source-function profile. Independent 11a59df evidence (FUNCTIONS-HTML5-20261027T0914Z) covers the corrected command workflow: omitted versus undefined typed values, supplied count/callee, fresh rest arrays, stable bound identity, tested ordinary borrowed receiver, constructor observations and pre-mutation ArgumentError refusals with Restart. The original arguments.length instrumentation changed allow-extra behavior and remains separate; unobserved signatures/coercions/reflection/global-scope behavior are not accepted.

features.title: this and method binding
features.scope: Handler-level declared methods retain the handler owner when detached. Project declared methods retain stable bound instance/static receivers; explicit super method calls use the current instance.
features.limitations: General nested/expression-function receiver/global semantics remain incomplete; accessors and the complete Flash object model are not implemented. Independent 11a59df evidence (FUNCTIONS-HTML5-20261027T0914Z) covers the corrected command workflow: omitted versus undefined typed values, supplied count/callee, fresh rest arrays, stable bound identity, tested ordinary borrowed receiver, constructor observations and pre-mutation ArgumentError refusals with Restart. The original arguments.length instrumentation changed allow-extra behavior and remains separate; unobserved signatures/coercions/reflection/global-scope behavior are not accepted.

features.title: Annotations and type system
features.scope: Selected primitive/Error defaults and coercions for handler bindings, arguments and returns; resolved project-class/native facade types; project class slot descriptors enforce supported defaults, writes and const protection across aliases. Resolved project interfaces support nominal typed fields/arguments/returns/casts; accessor arguments and returns use the existing coercion profile.
features.limitations: No complete AS3 type checker/VM. Old handler var declarations still do not create globally enforced class slots. Typed member assignment-expression results, complete host ownership/type rules and initialization conformance remain pending. The interfaces-accessors ordinary-export/real-WASM component scenario and representative browser model updates/Restart passed; unobserved contract paths remain separate, and no full AVM2 conformance is claimed.

features.title: Throw, catch and finally
features.scope: Throw, ordered catches for selected types, separate catch scopes, finally and abrupt-completion precedence.
features.limitations: Catches for arbitrary classes/interfaces, boxed-primitive equivalence and complete AVM2 error mapping are absent.

features.title: Error objects
features.scope: A limited set of core Error constructors, message, name, errorID and toString.
features.limitations: General class construction, getStackTrace, complete prototype semantics and all Flash error codes are absent. Independent eddcc30 finding AMF-TYPED-CATCH-001 (STORAGE-AMF-HTML5-20261027T0728Z) demonstrates that malformed ByteArray.readObject throws a raw string, bypassing catch(Error). The catch(*) positive control is separately documented; general native Error object recovery remains unverified. Independent c10e19e regression (FORMS-HTML5-20261027T0811Z) closes AMF-TYPED-CATCH-001 for the observed one-byte AMF10 failure: catch(Error) receives generic Error, position/length/byte stay 0/1/10 and the valid storage scene continues before and after Restart. EOFError, other native failures and full error-class fidelity are not accepted; the historical eddcc30 raw-string failure remains separately recorded.

features.title: Classes, inheritance and interfaces
features.scope: One AS3 class or interface per embedded source unit; constructors, public instance/static fields and get/set accessors, inherited property halves, super access, exact-signature project overrides and stable bound methods. Interfaces support multiple parents, exact public implementation checks, inherited implementations and nominal identity. Linked document/symbol classes initialize per active lifetime. Lexical public/private/protected/internal fields/methods/accessors, distinct owner-private slots, protected dispatch, package collaboration, final declarations and noninherited dynamic behavior now share the project trait registry.
features.limitations: Native interfaces/overrides and full lazy static dependency ordering remain unsupported. Read-only/write-only violations use explicit runtime errors; the static type checker and typed assignment-expression result semantics are incomplete. This is a bounded useful class profile, not full AS3. Independent a3fedc3 browser evidence covers the specific class/input scenarios in VERIFICATION.md; all untested members remain bounded or unverified. Independent 2b5deff evidence covers only the exact dynamic drawing/identity or binary packet scenarios in VERIFICATION.md; other members and native error/coercion fidelity remain unverified. The linked-movieclips ordinary-export/real-WASM host scenario passes; representative interactions and Restart also passed in the shared in-app-browser batch; VERIFICATION.md distinguishes visible evidence from host-only checks. The interfaces-accessors component scenario has bounded independent browser evidence; no full AVM2 conformance is claimed. Independent 798e28b evidence (LINKED-INTERFACES-HTML5-20261027T0243Z) applies only to the linked timeline and interface/accessor observations in VERIFICATION.md. AS2 host-error catch recovery, complete construction order and uncalled members remain unverified or outside the supported profile. The source-class/package delivery has its own bounded evidence; generalized static typing, custom namespaces, native overrides and complete initialization/reflection/VM conformance remain open. Independent 6687ced evidence (CLASSES-HTML5-20261027T1007Z) covers separate base/derived private state, an unchanged second model/retained identity, protected super dispatch, package-internal collaboration, public JSON and bounded sealed/public-computed ReferenceError refusals through Restart. Final declarations were used positively; illegal inheritance/override, generalized reflection and static initialization were not independently browser-tested. The private-spelling refusal may follow the unknown sealed-property guard rather than a private-specific error category.

features.title: Imports and project linking
features.scope: Optional packages, exact imports, same-package/qualified resolution, embedded source units and document/symbol linkage share a publication program. Unresolved/duplicate/cyclic types produce source-path diagnostics. Explicit library linkage IDs connect runtime creation to authored MovieClip symbols; exported linked classes must ultimately extend MovieClip. Interface units share exact import/type resolution, with cyclic and incompatible inherited contracts diagnosed. Immediate-package wildcard imports resolve embedded same-dialect types; AS3 internal class visibility is package-scoped and name collisions diagnose.
features.limitations: SWC/bytecode libraries, filesystem/network module discovery and a general dependency toolchain are absent. Mixed-dialect imports and JS/TS project modules remain unsupported; AS2 classes have their separate profile. Independent ed3c39b evidence covers only the specified typed geometry/Timer workflow; other members and full timing/coercion remain unverified. The linked-movieclips ordinary-export/real-WASM host scenario passes; representative interactions and Restart also passed in the shared in-app-browser batch; VERIFICATION.md distinguishes visible evidence from host-only checks. The interfaces-accessors ordinary-export/real-WASM component scenario and representative browser model updates/Restart passed; unobserved contract paths remain separate, and no full AVM2 conformance is claimed. Independent 6687ced evidence (CLASSES-HTML5-20261027T1007Z) covers positive immediate-package model/data and supported flash.display wildcard imports plus the same-package internal collaborator. It does not establish wildcard ambiguity, exact-import precedence, inaccessible-import rejection, subpackage expansion or external dependency loading.

features.title: Dynamic objects and prototypes
features.scope: Object literals, custom fields, property/index reads and explicitly defined function members.
features.limitations: There is no complete Object/prototype/scope-chain model; computed calls, general alias/type inference and some dynamic methods are rejected. Independent 6687ced evidence (CLASSES-HTML5-20261027T1007Z) covers adding/deleting theme on the explicit dynamic Record, public JSON, and the non-dynamic child rejecting an added note while preserving label/safe. This is the recorded source-object workflow, not a complete Object/prototype or reflection contract.

features.title: Property enumeration and with
features.scope: Bounded for-in property enumeration over ordinary records, Arrays and project objects; original-key membership and member/index deletion. AS3 for-each visits values; Vector/Dictionary retain typed indices and object-key identity. Fixed AS3 traits are excluded and protected from deletion.
features.limitations: Snapshot keys ignore later insertions, skip deletions and read values at visit time. Historical iteration order, with, XML/E4X and enumeration of hidden native/display storage remain unsupported. The combined typed-collections workflow supplies delivery evidence separately; this is not a full Flash enumeration contract. Independent 6396fd0 evidence (TYPED-COLLECTIONS-HTML5-20261027T0525Z) is restricted to the Item/InventoryCard Vector and strong Dictionary inventory→scene→JSON workflow, specific fixed/bounds/type rejection observations, key controls, recycled listener identity and Restart in VERIFICATION.md. Weak GC, native enumeration, general mutation/order/reentry, other specializations and Dictionary serialization do not inherit the pass. Independent 6687ced evidence (CLASSES-HTML5-20261027T1007Z) covers note and optional theme as dynamic keys while declared fixed/private fields stay out of this enumeration. Public JSON still includes label/safe and readable counter getters. Arbitrary key order/mutation, aliases, native storage and other serialization modes do not inherit this result.

features.title: Additional language operators
features.scope: new constructs resolved project classes, selected Error types and supported native value/event facades. Remaining is/as/instanceof/in/delete/unary void operators are still pending.
features.limitations: This does not implement all additional operators or arbitrary native construction; new native display placements are explicitly rejected.

features.title: Primitives and global conversions
features.scope: Number, Boolean, parseFloat, isNaN and isFinite retain JavaScript-backed conversions. String now uses the bounded primitive family facade; parseInt retains its separate pinned AS3 profile and earlier HTML5 acceptance.
features.limitations: Complete historical coercions, boxed values and the full standard library remain unfinished. Array/String expectations are documented_only; the combined browser pipeline passed without original Flash comparison.

features.title: Math
features.scope: A closed list of numeric Math methods, including trigonometry, abs, min/max, pow, random and round. Exact project imports also expose finite Point/Rectangle/Matrix values: point arithmetic, rectangle queries and affine matrix construction/composition/inversion/coordinate mapping. Display bounds and coordinate conversion use the same value classes. Runtime Transform/ColorTransform adds exact affine overrides, copy-valued geometry getters, skew-preserving scalar mutation, nested RGBA paint composition and independent tinted views of shared pixels.
features.limitations: Execution is delegated to JavaScript; the full contract and numerical equivalence with Flash are not certified. The shared geometry profile requires finite numbers and rejects overflow/singular inversion; 3D values and complete historical coercion/native-slot behavior remain pending. Runtime Transform uses logical stage coordinates and bounded finite values; native script preview/authoring skew, browser-window mapping and exact raster pixelBounds are not claimed. The combined geometry/Timer browser workflow and Restart passed. The combined Transform workflow passed actual-WASM and in-app-browser Cycle/Restart; independent declaration audit and exact historical conformance remain separate.

features.title: Collections, strings, dates and data APIs
features.scope: Bounded Array constructors and mutation/slicing, comparator/flag sort and multi-field sortOn; primitive String conversion, UTF-16 access/search/slicing/splitting/concatenation/casing. Shared adapters preserve custom overrides and lookup order in handlers and project methods. AS3 adds Array callbacks/search and literal-pattern String replacement. The earlier primitive toFixed adapter remains available. Date adds current/millisecond/component construction, UTC/local getters and setters, static UTC/parse, modern browser date strings and native-branded values shared between compiled units. AS3 adds Date accessors and toJSON, constructor-based RegExp with exec/test and String match/search/regex replacement/splitting, and bounded JSON parse/stringify with callbacks, property lists, readable public class getters and toJSON.
features.limitations: Partial profiles: 1,000,000 array entries/string code units or results; ordinary records, restricted sortOn options, no native method extraction/prototype augmentation, custom string-pattern objects, locale operations or complete historical coercion/order. AS3 NUMERIC requires numeric values; AS2 boxed String is unsupported. See fixture profile constants for exact dialect limits. The combined collection/text browser scenario passed; this does not establish every method. Date parsing/locale/DST follows the modern browser backend. RegExp uses native JavaScript with g/i/m/s plus ASCII extended x; known unsupported PCRE syntax diagnoses, literals remain unsupported, and input/output bounds are not a hard match-time limit. JSON is bounded to 1000000 UTF-16 units, 128 containers and 100000 visited values; unsupported native objects need a replacer/toJSON. Initial data-processing delivery verification is recorded separately. Independent 7ed1605 evidence (DATA-HTML5-20261027T0452Z) covers the actual planning JSON reviver, simple RegExp captures/String transformations, public Report getter serialization, explicit native-object replacer, selected UTC leap/month/year boundaries and Restart in VERIFICATION.md. Nine UTC timestamps match Python datetime; full callback/property-order/class behavior, locale/DST/parsing, PCRE parity and backtracking time bounds remain unverified.

features.title: Trace through the browser host
features.scope: trace from handlers and nested functions runs through the host, updating the console and player status line.
features.limitations: This implements the observable NeoFlash output channel; complete formatting of all Flash types is not claimed.

features.title: MovieClip and timelines
features.scope: Void play/stop/gotoAndPlay/gotoAndStop/nextFrame/prevFrame, current/total frames, named children and independent nested clocks. Linked authored classes initialize per active placement lifetime. Explicitly exported MovieClip symbols provide independent scoped authored timelines, nested clocks/scripts and linked class state; new on the linked MovieClip class allocates its authored library timeline.
features.limitations: Full construction/re-entry/scenes, unrestricted authored-list mutation and original Flash lifecycle order remain unverified. Linked child-before-container initialization is the current bounded host contract. The linked-movieclips ordinary-export/real-WASM host scenario passes; representative interactions and Restart also passed in the shared in-app-browser batch; VERIFICATION.md distinguishes visible evidence from host-only checks. Independent 798e28b evidence (LINKED-INTERFACES-HTML5-20261027T0243Z) applies only to the linked timeline and interface/accessor observations in VERIFICATION.md. AS2 host-error catch recovery, complete construction order and uncalled members remain unverified or outside the supported profile.

features.title: Display properties
features.scope: Position, alpha, scale, bounded finite rotation readback, visibility, names, root/parent/stage, child traversal, transformed bounds and coordinates, and supported nonrotated width/height writes. Native Sprite/Shape/MovieClip and project subclasses allocate stable runtime objects; containers add/remove/reparent/reorder dynamic children in an ordered suffix after authored children. Explicitly exported MovieClip symbols provide independent scoped authored timelines, nested clocks/scripts and linked class state; new on the linked MovieClip class allocates its authored library timeline. Bitmap is a noncontainer display view over shared BitmapData with smoothing and pixel-snapping controls. Runtime Transform/ColorTransform adds exact affine overrides, copy-valued geometry getters, skew-preserving scalar mutation, nested RGBA paint composition and independent tinted views of shared pixels. Runtime vector mask assignment and copied integral scrollRect state clip nested targets while preserving live identities; content coordinate offsets and viewport bounds share the Rust graph. Scripted HTML5 filters add copied Blur/Glow/DropShadow/ColorMatrix values, shared bounded Rust RGBA kernels and ordered whole-subtree groups, including nested effects and deferred owner mask/scroll clipping. Runtime BitmapData image processing adds color/filter operations and current subtree capture through the shared scene painter; AS3 adds bulk ByteArray transfer and PNG encoding with Loader round-trip. Shared input state adds mouseEnabled/mouseChildren, buttonMode/useHandCursor and stable hitArea references. A publication owns one copied-bounds drag operation, transformed local mouse coordinates, bounds/shape point queries and object-bound intersections. AS2 uses its numeric startDrag/hitTest overloads and local mouse/drop-path aliases.
features.limitations: General authored/dynamic display mixing, alpha masks/remaining filters, full text layout and all owner-specific native APIs remain incomplete. Rotated dimension setters and singular coordinate conversions diagnose. Representative family behavior passed in the shared in-app-browser batch; this is not full API or cross-engine acceptance. Independent ed3c39b evidence covers only the specified typed geometry/Timer workflow; other members and full timing/coercion remain unverified. Authored children cannot be moved/removed; detached runtime objects remain allocated until Restart, with a 4,096-object bound. General Flash depth replacement and full linked construction order remain unsupported. The combined dynamic-display browser workflow and Restart passed. Independent 2b5deff evidence covers only the exact dynamic drawing/identity or binary packet scenarios in VERIFICATION.md; other members and native error/coercion fidelity remain unverified. The linked-movieclips ordinary-export/real-WASM host scenario passes; representative interactions and Restart also passed in the shared in-app-browser batch; VERIFICATION.md distinguishes visible evidence from host-only checks. Independent 798e28b evidence (LINKED-INTERFACES-HTML5-20261027T0243Z) applies only to the linked timeline and interface/accessor observations in VERIFICATION.md. AS2 host-error catch recovery, complete construction order and uncalled members remain unverified or outside the supported profile. The bitmap-pixels family passes separate ordinary-export/real-WASM and in-app-browser checks for visible shared edits, source/clone independence, AS2 attachment and Restart. Native image-panel acceptance remains pending; full rasterization and coercion parity are not established. Independent 1bd0e3c evidence (BITMAP-HTML5-20261027T0345Z) is restricted to the PNG/shared pixel, AS2 attachment, disposal and Restart observations in VERIFICATION.md. JPEG, rasterization options, alpha hits and native image authoring do not inherit that pass. The combined Transform workflow passed actual-WASM and in-app-browser Cycle/Restart; independent declaration audit and exact historical conformance remain separate. Independent 852c8b7 evidence (TRANSFORMS-HTML5-20261027T0502Z) covers the specified affine/skew/reparent, tint/alpha pixels and real coordinate hits, copy ownership and Restart workflow in VERIFICATION.md. Native editing, exact rasterization, dynamic-card keyboard/accessibility and unobserved members do not inherit that pass. Vector-only/static source restrictions and immediate integral scroll rectangles are explicit; native clipping authoring and historical fractional/deferred behavior remain pending. Independent 05d5d43 evidence (CLIPPING-HTML5-20261027T0652Z) covers the observed vector mask, copied integral scroll rectangles, actual hole/ring/circle and clipped-card hits, instance continuity and Restart in VERIFICATION.md. The parent right-edge intersection is not independently isolated; three visible semantic entries do not establish full accessibility. Alpha masks, source reuse/retirement, budgets and historical fractional/deferred behavior are not inferred. This runtime-only filter profile has its own gallery evidence; native filter authoring, remaining classes, cacheAsBitmap, exact Flash kernels/coercions and high-density raster fidelity remain pending. Active native DOM editing under a filtered ancestor is an explicit composition boundary. Original geometry supplies input and semantics; effect halos do not extend them. Independent 5395375 evidence (FILTERS-HTML5-20261027T0844Z) covers the observed four mixed-content cards, nested bitmap ColorMatrix, copied values/arrays, selected failure preservation, unchanged 144 shared source pixels, nonselectable-caption and halo-excluded hits, clear/restore and Restart. It does not establish general atomicity, filtered DOM input/IME, mask/scroll composition, HiDPI/cache limits or all filter members. The image pipeline remains bounded: normal draw blending, integer regions, no external mask dependencies, no display filters during draw, partial setPixels underrun, and separate native authoring/exact raster acceptance. Independent 6f4f66a evidence (IMAGE-PIPELINE-HTML5-20261027T0943Z) covers complete initial source/tint arithmetic and captured/roundtrip/loaded PNG RGBA, bulk words/cursors, partial setPixels EOF and the observed generic color Error. Later palette/Restart states have screenshot/AX evidence only where logs were unavailable; no repeated full-byte or full-run zero-error claim follows. Draw/filter/encoder combinations, exact Flash rasterization and native authoring remain bounded or unverified. Pointer behavior is a bounded 2D browser profile: self/cyclic hitArea links reject, drag cancellation on reparenting is explicit, and exact glyph/filter/transparent-fill/historical input fidelity remains pending. AS2 enabled, trackAsMenu, multi-touch and 3D are not implied by the new mouse flags. Controlled pointer events prove wiring; native browser gestures have separate evidence. The drag delivery separately passed real AS2/AS3 browser drags, invisible donor margin, child/disabled targeting, outside release and fresh Restart callbacks; existing linked-card Canvas and keyboard activation also passed. Native capture-at-Restart and cursor values retain controlled-helper evidence. Full declaration promotion remains a separate audit.

features.title: Events and handlers
features.scope: Shared EventDispatcher add/remove/has/willTrigger/dispatch with capture/target/bubble, priorities, phase snapshots, cancellation and redispatch cloning. Event/MouseEvent/KeyboardEvent facades, Stage dimensions/frameRate/focus and bounded pointer/keyboard input share placement lifetimes. Imported Timer/TimerEvent add start/stop/reset, delay/repeatCount/currentCount/running, TIMER then TIMER_COMPLETE, listener dispatch and updateAfterEvent. Imported getTimer reads elapsed session milliseconds; Restart cancels old timers/listeners and rebases the clock. Pointer capture and outside release share the drag lifecycle; AS2 gains onRelease/onReleaseOutside/onRollOver/onRollOut, and mouse target flags/cursor preferences are resolved against the current Rust display graph.
features.limitations: Aggregation targets, full lifecycle/broadcast ordering, AS3 GC equivalence, fullscreen/scale modes, IME/touch and complete focus/input behavior remain pending. Exposed constants do not imply automatic lifecycle events; current fitted export has fixed logical Stage dimensions. Representative Stage behavior passed in the shared in-app-browser batch; native Sources and broader input acceptance remain pending. Independent frozen-01f1381 browser verification found trusted mouse click events with isPrimary=false dropped by the shared Stage guard; semantic Enter and keyboard paths passed. The corrected input route passed coordinate clicks and Restart in the original class/Stage examples; an unlocated aggregate observer exception remains open. Timers accept finite bounded delays/repeat counts, schedule at least 1 ms and allow 1,024 concurrent runs by default. Browser throttling/catch-up, historical coercion/error IDs, public interval/timeout facades and full native inheritance remain outside this profile; the combined geometry/Timer browser workflow and Restart passed. Independent a3fedc3 browser evidence covers the specific class/input scenarios in VERIFICATION.md; all untested members remain bounded or unverified. Independent ed3c39b evidence covers only the specified typed geometry/Timer workflow; other members and full timing/coercion remain unverified. Independent c10e19e evidence (FORMS-HTML5-20261027T0811Z) adds the observed textInput cancellation, actual-change-only notification, two-field Tab/focus and fresh post-Restart event counts. Programmatic replacement does not synthesize user events in this workflow; full input/focus/IME/overlay behavior remains unverified. This family has separate grouped input/drag verification; exact historical event ordering, all native-text/semantic combinations, multi-touch and other browser engines remain unverified. The drag delivery separately passed real AS2/AS3 browser drags, invisible donor margin, child/disabled targeting, outside release and fresh Restart callbacks; existing linked-card Canvas and keyboard activation also passed. Native capture-at-Restart and cursor values retain controlled-helper evidence. Full declaration promotion remains a separate audit.

features.title: Programmatic drawing
features.scope: Runtime Sprite/Shape/MovieClip Graphics provides solid/linear/radial gradient fill and stroke, cubic and rounded paths, Vector/array drawPath, copied Graphics state and exact enum imports. Owner-supplied typed facades reject direct construction/inheritance.
features.limitations: Initial gradients support pad/rgb, 1..15 ordered stops, copied finite invertible matrices and focal ratios within -1..1. Authored-owner drawing, hairlines, non-round stroke modes, bitmap fills, alpha masks/filters, native gradient tools and full historical paint/coercion semantics remain pending. Storage is bounded; prior independent solid-drawing evidence does not promote the new gradient declarations. Per-corner drawRoundRectComplex is a NeoFlash extension and does not count toward the Flash API catalogue. Independent 08f1d9c evidence (GRAPHICS-HTML5-20261027T0619Z) covers the observed pad/RGB paints, gradient stroke, Vector/cubic paths, copied-paint independence, real input/lifetime and Restart workflow in VERIFICATION.md. Incomplete-path bounds preservation is not full atomicity; alpha/stroke-edge fidelity, exact pixels, budgets and unobserved members remain unverified. drawRoundRectComplex is a NeoFlash extension, not a catalogue API. Independent 05d5d43 evidence (CLIPPING-HTML5-20261027T0652Z) extends the earlier drawPath scope with array input for same-orientation closed contours and EVEN_ODD mask geometry: the visible hole excludes real hits while ring/circle regions work. Transparent filled mask geometry is not alpha-mask support or a general winding/raster oracle.

features.title: TextField and text APIs
features.scope: Plain authored and runtime-created text fields share Rust text/layout state: AS3 TextField/TextFormat/TextFormatAlign constructors/imports and typed native identities. Independent logical boxes, multiline/wordWrap, left/center/right alignment, uniform font/size/color/bold/italic/leading, separate current/insertion defaults, text/append/replace and UTF-16 line queries/metrics. Scripted HTML5 input adds native browser editing, Rust revision-checked user transactions, UTF-16 selection/replacement, user-only restrict/maxChars and password masking. AS3 TextFieldType/TextEvent/FocusEvent and AS2 Selection/onChanged/focus callbacks share Stage focus and publication lifetime.
features.limitations: Whole-field formatting only; differing insertion defaults cannot append/partially replace nonempty text without mixed-run support. No HTML/CSS, embedded fonts, advanced paragraph formats, justified alignment or native text subclass initialization. Text is bounded to 1 MiB UTF-8 per field, 16 MiB runtime override storage and 16,384 layout segments/lines, with complete Unicode replacement ranges. Long-token wrapping uses Unicode scalar boundaries, not grapheme segmentation. Installed-font measurements and shared Rust wrapping do not establish Flash layout/coercion parity. The earlier collection/text browser scenario retains its bounded evidence; the new text-layout ordinary-export/real-WASM workflow passes creation, reflow, independent formats, drawing/clip consumption, atomic mixed-run refusal and Restart. The in-app-browser workflow visibly passed reflow/alignment, independent fields and Restart; native interactive editing remains pending. Independent fba17ae evidence (TEXT-LAYOUT-HTML5-20261027T0409Z) covers only the actual uniform layout/format/refusal/Restart workflow in VERIFICATION.md. Native live editing, other fonts/engines, mixed runs and input/IME do not inherit the browser pass. The separate text-form delivery records current scripted input evidence; earlier layout evidence is unchanged. The active DOM field follows affine/vector clipping but is above foreground Canvas artwork. Native input-field authoring, full IME/locale/grapheme/original-player behavior, rich text and cross-engine metrics remain pending; AS2 general string target resolution is unsupported. Independent c10e19e evidence (FORMS-HTML5-20261027T0811Z) covers actual Cyrillic/Latin typing and paste, the observed restrict/maxChars profile, cancellable textInput, Tab/focus, selection and programmatic replacement without extra user events in examples/text-form.nflash. Exact 26/23-character saved values survive reload/Restart; active Restart discards the observed unsaved edit and removes its editor. Password/selectable behavior, IME, arbitrary overlays/rotation/clipping, full accessibility and native authoring remain unverified.

features.title: Audio, video and resource loading
features.scope: Authored embedded PNG/JPEG image placements use shared Rust decoding. BitmapData supports construction, pixel reads/writes, fillRect/copyPixels, clone/scroll and disposal over the shared pixel arena. AS3 Bitmap views share/replace bitmapData and expose smoothing plus PixelSnapping auto/always/never constants. AS3 Sound/SoundChannel/SoundTransform provide complete-file resource/HTTP GET loading, byte/duration state, millisecond playback offsets/repeats, channel stop/position, copied gain/pan transforms and completion events. Shared MP3/WAV preflight and publication-owned Web Audio lifecycle gate playback on user activation. File-video playback now adds local NetConnection/NetStream with embedded/native HTTP sources, metadata/status, playback controls and publication cleanup. AS3 Video can be constructed or authored; SoundTransform volume is copied.
features.limitations: Image loading has a separate bounded PNG/JPEG Loader record.
